configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Canonical release verification build with examples.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer build. macOS LeakSanitizer is unsupported; detect_leaks stays off.

configurePresets.name: no-exceptions
configurePresets.description: Exercises the fail-fast configuration: KARMA_THROW aborts instead of throwing. Exists so that configuration cannot silently rot again - it did not compile at all until the exception types were moved outside the feature guard.

testPresets.name: no-exceptions
testPresets.description: Selects binaries with no refusal assertions. With KARMA_ENABLE_EXCEPTIONS=OFF a refusal aborts, so a test asserting one cannot pass. Membership is EMPIRICAL - determined by running each binary in this build, not by grepping for a helper name; see cmake/karma_test_helpers.cmake for the regeneration loop and for the two static detectors that were tried and failed. Excluding by CTest label does not work: CTest re-adds a FIXTURES_SETUP test a selected test requires whatever label it carries. Do not add -R/-E on the command line - it REPLACES this filter rather than narrowing it.
